title: The live view's sprint panel shows each active sprint's estimate range from mon_eta.estimate
goal: the sprint panel's text view writes on each active sprint's row the range mon_eta.estimate gives at the snapshot's taken time, as `LOW-HIGH min` the way --status sprints writes it; the panel's range moves with the snapshot's taken time; the sprint row's done_at, DONE_KEPT and done_commits, which no reader needs any more, are removed

run: import inspect,sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import mon_sprint as m; bad=[n for n in ("DONE_KEPT","done_commits") if hasattr(m,n)]+(["done_at"] if "done_at" in inspect.getsource(m.sprint_row) else []); print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: the sprint panel's text view writes on each active sprint's row the range mon_eta.estimate gives at the snapshot's taken time, as `LOW-HIGH min` the way --status sprints writes it
the panel's range moves with the snapshot's taken time
the sprint row's done_at, DONE_KEPT and done_commits, which no reader needs any more, are removed
